title: neoporteria odieri var. malleolata
intro: Neoporteria odieri var. malleolata, commonly known as Puna Cactus, is a plant species found in the Andean region. It is known for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and pain, and exhibiting antioxidant and antibacterial activities. The health benefits of Neoporteria odieri var. malleolata include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and promoting wound healing due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which have been identified in various studies.
